name: field
title: Field
description: Wraps a control with label, helper, and error so the whole row stays aligned. Required around every form input.
docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

configurables.what: Marks the field as required in the label UI.
configurables.how: true when the form blocks submit without this value; still validate in code. Default: false.
true when the field is locked by plan; prefer explaining why nearby. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Pass htmlFor matching the control id, or wrap a single control so the label associates; put error text in error prop for aria-describedby patterns.
Field does not render the input itself — children must be Input/Select/Textarea/etc.
